mission.heading: The board has chosen you.
paragraphs: Behind an attic wall waits an old game that plays back. Its board is a living world: jungle, desert, marsh and a drowned temple.
Aarav and Zoya rolled its dice by accident. The attic is gone, and the Game's voice, the Keeper, will not let them leave.
You are with them. Survive six Perils, win six Tiles, and say the Keeper's sentence before the sand runs out. You have ten minutes.
mission.speaker: keeper

cards.text: Drag to look around the room.
Tap things to find items, read clues and look closer. Items fly to your Casebook.
Open the Casebook. It holds your Clues, Items, Rule Pages and Tiles.
Tap the dice if you are stuck. A hint costs 25 Pips and you get 6 hints in the whole game.
Your time, your Pips (score) and the Danger. A wrong answer costs 10 Pips and 10 seconds and raises Danger. At 100% the Peril catches you.

opening.speaker: zoya
opening.text: Aarav, look. Nani's old trunk. There is a box on it.

opening.card: The carved box, a folded note
opening.speaker: aarav
opening.text: A note. 'Do not play. If you do, finish.' Funny, Nani.

opening.card: The lid opens, a board glows
opening.speaker: zoya
opening.text: The board is moving. Aarav, put it down!

opening.card: Two dice roll across the board alone
opening.speaker: keeper
opening.text: Two players. At last. Roll accepted.

opening.card: Flash. The room sharpens, vines burst through the floor
opening.speaker: aarav
opening.text: Zoya, hold my hand. Whatever this is, we stay together.

opening.speaker: keeper
opening.text: Six Perils. Six Tiles. One sentence. The sand is running.

idle.speaker: zoya
idle.text: What haven't we looked at yet?

r1_enter_keeper.speaker: keeper
r1_enter_keeper.text: Roll accepted. The Peril is vines. They grow while you hesitate.

r1_enter_zoya.speaker: zoya
r1_enter_zoya.text: The door is sealed. We need the board. Check the box lid.

r1_note_l.speaker: aarav
r1_note_l.text: Torn in six. Each piece wears an animal. So we search for six pieces.

r1_die_l.speaker: zoya
r1_die_l.text: Four pips. Remember that. The board will want it.

r1_w1.speaker: zoya
r1_w1.text: That does not fit. Look at the animals on the edges.

r1_w2.speaker: aarav
r1_w2.text: The inside of the box lid shows the animal order. Check it.

r1_w3.speaker: zoya
r1_w3.text: Heron at the top. Then clockwise: tortoise, gecko, bat, fox, moth.

r1_mv1.speaker: zoya
r1_mv1.text: That is not where the die points. Think about the die.

r1_mv2.speaker: aarav
r1_mv2.text: The die beside the box showed four pips. Count four squares.

r1_mv3.speaker: zoya
r1_mv3.text: Start on square zero. Move four. The brass key square.

r1_keeper_move.speaker: keeper
r1_keeper_move.text: Roll accepted. Move your token as the die shows.

r1_right_a.speaker: aarav
r1_right_a.text: It fits! The board is whole.

r1_right_z.speaker: zoya
r1_right_z.text: Finish what you begin. Nani wrote it for a reason.

r1_right_k.speaker: keeper
r1_right_k.text: Acceptable. Take your Tile and your light. Walk on.

r2_enter_keeper.speaker: keeper
r2_enter_keeper.text: The Peril is a fall. The bridge is old and I am impatient.

r2_enter_zoya.speaker: zoya
r2_enter_zoya.text: There is carving on that rock, but it is too dark to read. We need light.

r2_bridge_l.speaker: aarav
r2_bridge_l.text: Each row has its own sign. A flower, a nest, a bird. Remember them.

r2_w1.speaker: zoya
r2_w1.text: That plank is not safe. Read the poem line for this row again.

r2_w2.speaker: aarav
r2_w2.text: Check the picture of the bridge. Each row has its own sign.

r2_w3.speaker: zoya
r2_w3.text: Row by row: the flower, away from the nest and bat, the bird, far from the cut rope, the ribbon.

r2_right_z.speaker: zoya
r2_right_z.text: You held my hand and I held the rope. We trusted each other.

r2_right_k.speaker: keeper
r2_right_k.text: Hmph. A bridge holds when two walk it. Take your Tile.

r3_enter_keeper.speaker: keeper
r3_enter_keeper.text: The Peril is thunder on four legs. Ridgehorns do not stop for children.

r3_enter_aarav.speaker: aarav
r3_enter_aarav.text: That deep drum has fallen. We need to hang it up.

r3_prints_l.speaker: zoya
r3_prints_l.text: The prints are fresh and coming closer.

r3_log_l.speaker: zoya
r3_log_l.text: Big circle, deep drum. Small circle, high drum. Easy once you see it.

r3_w1.speaker: aarav
r3_w1.text: Not that beat. Listen again. The drums play the pattern first.

r3_w2.speaker: zoya
r3_w2.text: The carved log shows which circle is which drum. Check it.

r3_w3.speaker: aarav
r3_w3.text: Round one is deep, high, mid. Each round adds one beat at the end.

r3_right_k.speaker: keeper
r3_right_k.text: The beat comes before the step. You learn. Take your Tile.

r4_enter_keeper.speaker: keeper
r4_enter_keeper.text: The Peril is water. Slow, patient, and never lost.

r4_enter_zoya.speaker: zoya
r4_enter_zoya.text: A big door with a sun-socket. And a stone that sounds hollow.

r4_carving_l.speaker: aarav
r4_carving_l.text: Each mirror turns the light a different way. Good to know.

r4_w1.speaker: aarav
r4_w1.text: The light missed the sun-stone. Where did the beam end?

r4_w2.speaker: zoya
r4_w2.text: The wall carving says how each mirror turns the light. Read it.

r4_w3.speaker: aarav
r4_w3.text: The top mirror sends it down. The next sends it left. The last sends it down to the stone.

r4_right_z.speaker: zoya
r4_right_z.text: The stone is glowing! The door is opening.

r4_right_a.speaker: aarav
r4_right_a.text: I found the lamp, you found the carving. We shared it.

r4_right_k.speaker: keeper
r4_right_k.text: Light that is passed on shines further. Take your Tile.

r5_enter_keeper.speaker: keeper
r5_enter_keeper.text: The Peril is sand, and something long and hungry beneath it.

r5_enter_aarav.speaker: aarav
r5_enter_aarav.text: Five awnings. One of them must be safe.

r5_scroll_l.speaker: zoya
r5_scroll_l.text: The last glyph is too faded. Maybe we can make it clearer.

r5_w1.speaker: zoya
r5_w1.text: That does not spell a word. Match each glyph to the carved key.

r5_w2.speaker: aarav
r5_w2.text: The well carving is the key. One glyph, one letter.

r5_w3.speaker: zoya
r5_w3.text: Circle with a dot is B. Waves are L. Crescent is U. Check the last glyph in the key.

r5_right_z.speaker: zoya
r5_right_z.text: The merchant wrote it plainly, for strangers. He told the truth.

r5_right_k.speaker: keeper
r5_right_k.text: An honest word finds the shelter. How tiresome. Take your Tile.

r6_enter_keeper.speaker: keeper
r6_enter_keeper.text: The Peril is fog. You cannot see the way, so you may as well hurry.

r6_enter_zoya.speaker: zoya
r6_enter_zoya.text: That cauldron is full of mud. We need to wash it.

r6_card_l.speaker: aarav
r6_card_l.text: Four herbs, in order. Careful. The order matters.

r6_w1.speaker: aarav
r6_w1.text: The cauldron is fizzing red. That herb is not next.

r6_w2.speaker: zoya
r6_w2.text: The recipe card gives the order. Read each line.

r6_w3.speaker: aarav
r6_w3.text: Floats, white bells, sharp smell, red berries. And never the black flower.

r6_right_z.speaker: zoya
r6_right_z.text: The fog is thinning. Do not touch anything.

r6_right_k.speaker: keeper
r6_right_k.text: Fog lifts for the patient. You are slower than I hoped. Take your Tile.

r7_enter_keeper.speaker: keeper
r7_enter_keeper.text: Last roll. The Peril is the board itself. Its dice fall when you are wrong.

r7_enter_zoya.speaker: zoya
r7_enter_zoya.text: There is a hole in the middle. The seed pod from the marsh?

r7_keeper_l.speaker: keeper
r7_keeper_l.text: Say my sentence. Use your Tiles. Use my own words, not yours.

r7_w1.speaker: zoya
r7_w1.text: That does not match the Keeper's words. Open the Casebook.

r7_w2.speaker: aarav
r7_w2.text: Each Rule Page starts with the same words as a blank.

r7_w3.speaker: zoya
r7_w3.text: The Rule Pages match the blanks in the order of the rooms, from the attic to the marsh.

r7_right_a.speaker: aarav
r7_right_a.text: Finish, trust, listen, share, speak, wait.

r7_right_k.speaker: keeper
r7_right_k.text: ...Yes. Every one. The sentence is spoken.

tease_2.speaker: keeper
tease_2.text: Take your time. I have all of it.

hints_out.speaker: zoya
hints_out.text: We are out of hints. Look again, slowly.

r7_warn_2.speaker: keeper
r7_warn_2.text: Once more, and the dice crush you.

timeUp.title: Time up
timeUp.line: The sand is gone. The Game keeps you for one more round.

what.play: Drag to look around. Tap things that glow.
what.holding: Tap the thing you want to use it on.

casebook.title: Casebook
casebook.emptyClues: Nothing saved yet. Tap glowing things to learn.
casebook.emptyPages: Win a Tile to earn a Rule Page.

ui.holdChip: Holding: {name}. Tap here to put it away.
ui.needItem: You need an item for this. Open the Casebook, pick it in Items, then tap here.
ui.noPips: Not enough Pips for a hint.
ui.patience: Stay still. Do not touch anything.

caught.title: Caught by the Peril
caught.line: {name} got you. The Game keeps you for one more round.

shattered.title: Crushed by the dice
shattered.line: Three wrong words. The Game keeps you for one more round.

rooms.title: Attic Study
rooms.objectiveCard: Nani's board is torn in six. Find every piece, then finish the board.

card.title: Nani's note
card.text: The board is torn in six. Each piece wears an animal.

views.caption: Six animals in a ring, clockwise from the top: heron, tortoise, gecko, bat, fox, moth.

card.title: Box lid
card.text: Six animals in a ring, clockwise from the top: heron, tortoise, gecko, bat, fox, moth.

views.caption: The top face shows four pips.
Turned on its side. Four pips on top.

card.title: The die
card.text: Four pips.

card.title: Heron piece
card.text: A board piece wearing a heron, tucked between the armchair cushions. It may fit the torn board.

card.title: Tortoise piece
card.text: You lifted the rolled rug. A piece wearing a tortoise lay under it.

views.caption: A brass globe. Something is stuck to its side.
Turned until the latch faces you (look at the glowing ring). It opens: a gecko piece!

card.title: Gecko piece
card.text: The globe's latch hid a piece wearing a gecko.

views.caption: Nani, smiling. The frame feels heavy.
A slot on the back holds a piece wearing a bat.

card.title: Bat piece
card.text: The slot behind Nani's photo held a piece wearing a bat.

card.title: Fox piece
card.text: A piece wearing a fox was tucked in the hollow head of the rocking horse.

card.title: Moth piece
card.text: A piece wearing a moth, inside the small chest by the globe.

hotspots.label: Door
hotspots.fx: The vines pull back and the door glows.

rooms.title: Canopy Bridge
rooms.objective: Read the carving and cross the bridge

card.title: The carving lights up
card.text: Lantern light shows lines cut deep into the mossy rock.

card.title: The carved poem
card.text:
1. Where the red flower blooms, put down your foot.
2. Not under the nest, and not where the bat hangs. Take what is left.
3. Follow the blue bird. It sings from the safe plank.
4. The cut rope hangs on one side. Walk as far from it as the bridge allows.
5. The last plank wears a yellow ribbon.

views.caption: Row 1: a red flower grows beside the left plank.
Row 2: a nest hangs above the middle plank and a bat hangs above the left plank.
Row 3: a blue bird sits on the middle plank.

card.title: Bridge, rows 1 to 3
card.text:
Row 1: a red flower beside the left plank.
Row 2: a nest above the middle plank, a bat above the left plank.
Row 3: a blue bird on the middle plank.

views.caption: Row 4: a cut rope hangs on the left.
Row 5: a yellow ribbon is tied on the middle plank.

card.title: Bridge, rows 4 and 5
card.text:
Row 4: a cut rope hangs on the left.
Row 5: a yellow ribbon on the middle plank.

hotspots.label: Platform
hotspots.fx: You cross to the far platform together.

rooms.objectiveCard: The bridge is old. Read the carving, learn the signs, then cross.

rooms.title: Drum Clearing
rooms.objective: Wake the drums before the herd arrives

card.title: Hoof prints
card.text: Giant prints, fresh, and coming closer. The Ridgehorns are near.

views.caption: Three rows of circles. Big circle: deep drum. Medium circle: middle drum. Small circle: high drum.

card.title: Beat log
card.text: Big circle = deep drum. Medium = middle drum. Small = high drum.

card.title: The drum is hoisted
card.text: The rope loops over the branch. The deep drum swings up where it can be played.

views.caption: The deep drum, red paint. It plays a low boom.
The middle drum, green paint.
The high drum, yellow paint. It plays a quick tap.

card.title: The three drums
card.text: Deep drum = red. Middle drum = green. High drum = yellow.

rooms.objectiveCard: A herd is coming. Hang the fallen drum and answer the Keeper's rhythm.

rooms.title: Sunken Temple

views.caption: A mirror leans one of two ways. A Slash mirror leans like /. A Back mirror leans the other way.
Light going east: Back turns it south, Slash turns it north. Light going south: Back turns it east, Slash turns it west. Light going west: Slash turns it south, Back turns it north.

card.title: Mirror guide
card.text:
A mirror leans one of two ways. A Slash mirror leans like /. A Back mirror leans the other way.
Light going east: Back turns it south, Slash turns it north. Light going south: Back turns it east, Slash turns it west. Light going west: Slash turns it south, Back turns it north.

views.caption: The beam enters at the left of row 1, going east. The sun-stone sits in column 2, row 4. Mirrors stand at column 3 row 1, column 3 row 3 and column 2 row 3.

card.title: The floor grid
card.text: The beam enters at the left of row 1, going east. The sun-stone sits in column 2, row 4. Mirrors: column 3 row 1 (A), column 3 row 3 (B), column 2 row 3 (C).

card.title: The stone slides
card.text: You knock. The hollow stone slides aside and a crystal lamp lights in the niche.

hotspots.label: Sun-stone and door
hotspots.fx: The sun-stone glows and the great door slides open.

rooms.objectiveCard: Water is rising. Light the sun-stone with the three mirrors.

rooms.title: Dune Bazaar

views.caption: The key chart carved in the well. One glyph, one letter.
More of the key chart.

card.title: The key chart
card.text: Circle with a dot = B. Two waves = L. Crescent = U. Triangle = E. Arrow = R. Key = D. Leaf = G. Diamond = N. Star = Y.

views.caption: The merchant's scroll says SHELTER above four glyphs. The last glyph is too faded to read.
Written below: Not the colour of fire. Not the colour of grass.

card.title: The merchant's scroll
card.text: SHELTER, four glyphs (the last one faded), and the line: Not the colour of fire. Not the colour of grass.

card.title: The glyph is clear
card.text: Through the Sun-glass the last glyph shows: a triangle.

hotspots.label: Blue awning
hotspots.fx: The blue awning lifts. A safe cellar door is underneath.

rooms.objectiveCard: A sandstorm is coming. Read the merchant's word and find the safe awning.

rooms.title: Fog Marsh
rooms.objective: Brew the cure for the fog

card.title: The mud washes away
card.text: Clean water rinses the cauldron. It is ready for the cure.

views.caption: Cure for the fog. Add in this order.
Never add the herb with black flowers.

card.title: The recipe card
card.text:
Cure for the fog. Add in this order.
First, the herb that floats on water.
Second, the herb with white bell flowers.
Third, the herb with the sharp, cool smell.
Fourth, the herb with small red berries.
Never add the herb with black flowers.

views.caption: Pondleaf: round green leaves floating on a pond.
Marshbell: white bell-shaped flowers.
Reedmint: tall reed with a sharp, cool smell.
Redberry: small red berries.
Nightcap: black flowers and a bitter smell, with a warning mark.

card.title: The five herbs
card.text: Pondleaf floats on water. Marshbell has white bells. Reedmint has a sharp, cool smell. Redberry has small red berries. Nightcap has black flowers and a warning mark.

rooms.objectiveCard: The fog hides the way. Wash the cauldron and brew the cure in order.

rooms.title: Heart of the Board

card.title: A sprout grows
card.text: A golden sprout rises from the hub. The six Tile slots light up.

card.title: The Keeper's words
card.text: Say my sentence. Use your Tiles. Use my own words, not yours.

hotspots.label: The board
hotspots.fx: The cracks seal in golden light.

rooms.objectiveCard: The giant dice are coming down. Plant the seed, then say the Keeper's sentence.

piece_heron.name: Heron piece
piece_heron.desc: A board piece wearing a heron. It may fit the torn board.

piece_tortoise.name: Tortoise piece
piece_tortoise.desc: A board piece wearing a tortoise.

piece_gecko.name: Gecko piece
piece_gecko.desc: A board piece wearing a gecko.

piece_bat.name: Bat piece
piece_bat.desc: A board piece wearing a bat.

piece_fox.name: Fox piece
piece_fox.desc: A board piece wearing a fox.

piece_moth.name: Moth piece
piece_moth.desc: A board piece wearing a moth.

lantern.name: Lantern
lantern.desc: An old brass lantern. It can light dark carvings.

rope.name: Rope
rope.desc: A coil of thick rope. Strong enough to hoist something heavy.

drumstick.name: Drum stick
drumstick.desc: A wooden drum stick. Good for knocking on stone.

sunglass.name: Sun-glass
sunglass.desc: A round brass magnifier. It makes faded marks clear.

flask.name: Water flask
flask.desc: A leather flask full of clean water.

seedpod.name: Seed pod
seedpod.desc: A glowing green seed pod. It wants to be planted.

rules.text: Finish what you begin. A half-built board holds nothing.
Trust the one beside you. A bridge holds when two walk it.
Listen before you move. The beat comes before the step.
Share what you find. Light that is passed on shines further.
Speak the truth. An honest word finds the shelter.
Wait when the way is hidden. Fog lifts for the patient.

r1_jigsaw.title: Mend the board
r1_jigsaw.hint: Drag each piece into the hexagon.

r1_move.title: Your first move
r1_move.hint: Drag the token to a square.

r2_planks.title: Cross the bridge
r2_planks.hint: Tap one plank in each row, starting at row 1.

r3_rhythm.title: Answer the drums
r3_rhythm.hint: Watch the drums, then tap the same beats.

r4_mirrors.title: Release the light
r4_mirrors.hint: Tap a mirror to flip it, then release the light.

r5_decode.title: Read the merchant's word
r5_decode.hint: Set a letter under each glyph, then submit.

r6_herbs.title: Brew the cure
r6_herbs.hint: Match each herb on the shelf to the recipe, then drag it in.

r7_sentence.title: The Keeper's sentence

blanks.before: A player leaves the Game who can

r7_sentence.hint: Pick a Tile, then tap the blank it belongs in.

ending.card: The six Tiles rise and lock into the board. The cracks seal in golden light.
ending.speaker: keeper
ending.text: Six rules, spoken. I have kept many players. You are the first who needed each other.

ending.card: The dice float down and go dark.
ending.speaker: keeper
ending.text: Go home. Close the lid. Do not roll again.

ending.card: A bright flash. The attic at dawn, the box closed.
ending.speaker: zoya
ending.text: Nani finished it once too, didn't she?

ending.card: On the lid, a seventh Tile glows with a snow-capped peak.
ending.speaker: keeper
